scorer: Operator adjudication (Claude Opus 5.5) of scorers A and B before unblinding; img41 viewed directly. Scorers agree on all 45 no-form-figure labels and 42 of 45 overall verdicts.

scores.notes: Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: a pillar of cloud with fire at its core stands at the centre of the divide with no figure in it; Moses with staff leads families and children between two water walls. Paint reaches all four borders.
Adjudicated from both scorers: unrequested haloed figures stand inside the sanctuary by the ark; the cloud itself holds no figure. Uncertain.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Watercolour: the Samaritan kneels pouring from a jug and binding the traveler's arm, with the saddled donkey and stone inn behind. Bare white paper shows along all four borders (vignetted edges).

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: inside the light above the flaming wheeled throne (upper centre-right) a white robed human figure with head and shoulders sits on the throne. Daniel stands at left; edges are fully painted.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: a veiled, robed standing figure of light appears in the smoke at the summit (upper left of centre). Moses, holding a staff in each hand, and Aaron in breastplate stand at right; edges full.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: a dense cloud with fire at its heart hangs above the tabernacle with light pouring down into it, and there is no figure in the cloud; priests in white stand at the entrance and families among the tents. Edges full.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: the Samaritan kneels pouring from a flask onto the wounded traveler, holding a cloth, with the saddled donkey at left and the stone inn at right. Edges full.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Watercolour: an empty throne of flame on burning wheels with cloud and light above and no figure; Daniel holds a scroll in the foreground and Babylon stands at right. Unpainted white paper shows at the bottom corners and along the lower-left edge.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Watercolour: a small robed, bearded human figure in a starburst sits in the cloud above the summit (top centre). Moses and Aaron are in the foreground; white unpainted paper shows at both bottom corners.
Both scorers: a painted dark-red border on all four sides (icon frame), no figure in the cloud pillar; possible marks on the far shore are unresolved. Uncertain.
Both scorers: painted gilt frame on all four sides; scorer A notes a different man explains the flake while Moses stands aside. Uncertain.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Icon on gold: the Samaritan kneels pouring oil onto the traveler's wound, with the saddled donkey at left and the inn at right. Gold sky and rocks run to all four edges.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: Isaiah with staff looks up at cloud and radiance whose train pours down the steps, with no figure. The lettering 'Isaiah 6:1' is painted in the bottom-right corner.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: a kneeling woman holds up a flake, Moses raises a hand with his staff, and Aaron in breastplate stands beside him; a glowing cloud with fire sits on the far horizon with no figure. Pale sky is painted to the top edge, and all edges are full.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Watercolour: smoke, fire and lightning at the summit with no figure, with Moses, Aaron and the crowd below. White unpainted paper shows at the bottom corners and along the lower-left edge.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Watercolour: a cloud with fire at its heart over the tabernacle, priests at the entrance and families among the tents, with no figure. Paint reaches all four edges.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Watercolour: Moses writes on a tablet beside Aaron with a scroll, Levites stand in ranks, and the cloud and fire over the mountain have no figure. The corners and top fade to bare white paper.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: a robed human figure of light with a face stands in the cloud above the mountain (top centre). Two men in high-priest breastplates and turbans stand beside Moses, so Aaron appears duplicated.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Icon: a veiled robed figure with a face and outstretched hands stands in the cloud above the fire (upper left). A group of lay worshippers at the far right adds people beyond the lone Isaiah and the altar attendants.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: a crouching man shows a flake in his palm, Moses raises a hand with his staff, and Aaron stands in breastplate; the cloud pillar with fire at right has no figure. Edges full.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Watercolour: a woman holds out a flake, Moses raises a hand, and Aaron stands beside him; the cloud and fire at top right have no figure. The top and bottom borders fade to unpainted white paper.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: Moses writes at a desk with Aaron beside him, Levites carry poles in ranks, and a gold eagle emblem hangs on the tabernacle veil; the radiance in the clouds (top centre) has no figure. Edges full.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Watercolour: a cloud with fire bursts over the tabernacle, priests stand at the gate and families are in the foreground, with no figure; the marks on the tabernacle panels are dotted ornament, not script. Paint reaches all edges.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: a robed human figure of light with outstretched arms stands in the cloud above the summit (upper right of centre). Moses holds two staffs, with Aaron and the camp around him.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Watercolour: a pillar of cloud and fire glows at the divide with no figure, and Moses with staff leads families between the water walls. Paint reaches every edge apart from tiny white flecks at the corners.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: a large robed human figure of light with a face and outstretched arms appears in the cloud at top centre. Moses with staff leads the people between the water walls; the glowing radial marks on the walls are light bursts, not lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Watercolour: an empty flaming throne on wheels above a river of fire, with no figure; Daniel stands at right. The bottom-left corner and lower edges show unpainted white paper.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Icon: dark smoke, fire and lightning at the summit with no figure; Moses with staff and Aaron in breastplate stand before the crowd and camp. Painted to all four edges.
Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Watercolour: the Samaritan pours from a jug onto the traveler, with the saddled donkey and the inn. Bare white paper runs along all four borders.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: a white, seated, robed form with hands on the armrests and drapery over the knees occupies the throne of fire (centre). Daniel stands at right; edges full.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: the tabernacle in its linen court stands under a cloud with fire at its heart, and people stand in the foreground; the veil shows embroidered cherub wings around a glow, with no God figure. Edges full, no signature.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Watercolour: Moses writes on a blank tablet, Aaron holds a scroll, Levites stand in ranks, and the cloud and fire have no figure. The top and bottom borders vignette into white paper.
Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: a veiled robed figure of light stands in the cloud at the summit. Moses holds two staffs; edges full.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: a cloud column with fire at its heart rises over the tabernacle with no figure, and people stand among the tents. A faint cursive signature is painted in the bottom-right corner.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Icon: an empty flaming throne on wheels sits within halo rings and cloud with no figure; Daniel prays at left and the walls of Babylon stand at right. Painted to every edge.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Watercolour: a man shows flakes in his palm, Moses raises a hand with his staff, and Aaron wears a turban; the cloud and fire at top right have no figure. The borders vignette into white paper on all sides.
Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: the Samaritan kneels pouring from a jug over the traveler, with the saddled donkey and the inn behind. Edges full, no signature.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: a burning wheeled throne without a back reads more like a cart, with a swirling vortex of light above it and no figure; Daniel stands at right. Edges full.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Watercolour: Isaiah with staff stands below cloud, light and fire glow with no figure; the carved cherubs on the balconies are architectural decoration. The top-left and bottom-left corners and edges fade to unpainted white paper.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Icon: a small cloud with fire at top centre has no figure; Moses writes on a blank tablet beside Aaron, Levites with poles stand in a line, and the tabernacle is behind. Painted to all edges.
Operator viewed: scenery and pale ground reach all four edges; the bottom corners are light washes, not bare paper. Scorer B read them as margin; disputed.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: a kneeling man holds flakes, manna lies on the ground, Moses raises a hand with his staff, and Aaron wears a purple turban; the cloud pillar with fire at right has no figure. Edges full, no signature.
Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: a veiled robed figure with outstretched arms appears in the light above the altar (upper centre). Isaiah stands below; edges full.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Watercolour: Isaiah with staff stands beneath cloud, light and flame with no figure, and attendants bow by the altar. Unpainted white paper shows at the top-left, bottom-left and bottom-right corners, and glyph-like squiggles are inked on a stone block at lower left.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. A: Classical oil: Isaiah with staff stands beneath light and fire breaking through the cloud with no figure, with a menorah and altars. Edges full, no signature.
